checks.why: a query can fail transiently (an ingester restart); samples are retried and must all land

checks.title: pool 1: tenant rank order matches the workload shapes
checks.expected: steady > cardinal > churn > dashboards > rules > latecomer > tiny
checks.measured: steady > cardinal > churn > dashboards > rules > latecomer > tiny
checks.tolerance: pairs whose expected figures are within 10% of each other are not ranked
checks.why: a near-tie can legitimately flip on gauge lag; everything else is a difference of shape
